sections.title: Senses
sections.gloss: What it perceives. Everything here reads; nothing here acts.

organs.name: chronicle & journal
organs.what: Two records of the same day — sessions distilled into a dated, theme-tagged log of what he did, and beside it the companion record of what he thought.
organs.why: Herald's day review and every "what changed" answer stand on this. Known gaps: nightly cap, live-session blindness.

organs.name: distillery
organs.what: The intake sense — iOS share sheet into a local model into curated memory.
organs.why: The first filter is his own recorded principles applied on his own hardware. No feed ranking decides what resonates.

organs.name: email
organs.what: Local triage and drafting. Law 1 lives here by construction — cognition about mail never leaves the machine.
organs.why: Mail is the highest-density personal corpus there is. It's the last thing that should be rented out.

organs.name: eyes
organs.what: A five-minute rolling window of the screen, OCR'd locally, pruned every 60s. Retention is zero by contract.
organs.why: Lets him ask about what's on screen without narrating it — and forgets by design, which is why it's allowed to look at all.

organs.name: load ledger
organs.what: One board for every heavy tenant on the machine — resident models and their gigabytes, training runs, agent fleets, leases, the eyes — with conflicts named and the question to ask him pre-written. A menubar readout carries the same counts in the corner of his eye.
organs.why: Born the night three tenants fought blind over one memory pool and training OOM'd twice. A body that can't feel itself will keep doing that.

organs.name: scenario sense
organs.what: Classifies the present into six values — deep-work, late-session, just-returned, long-away-return, quiet-day, steady.
organs.why: What's relevant depends on what kind of moment it is. Recall keyed to the situation, not just the question.

organs.name: state header
organs.what: A typed situation block computed at every call: time since last contact and everything that happened inside that gap, maintainer criticals, dreams today, chronicle age, local-model reachability — each field stamped with its own provenance or the word unknown.
organs.why: Computed on arrival, never polled. A field it cannot verify says unknown rather than guessing, which is the only reason the block can be trusted at all.

organs.name: the repo eye
organs.what: Self-observation at the repository layer — the strange loop, watching its own source change.
organs.why: A mind that can't see its own body edits is guessing about itself.

organs.name: herald
organs.what: Nightly scout — reads Hacker News at 21:45, reviews the day's work from the chronicle, and files proposals plus a cohort watch for others building persistent minds.
organs.why: It ran four nights unattended while the laptop was shut. The gap: it reads 30 titles and opens none of them.

sections.title: Mind
sections.gloss: How it thinks. Three tiers of cognition, and the instruments that judge.

organs.name: agent loop
organs.what: The JSON tool loop behind every surface — memory, organs, dreams, dispatch, herald verbs, cloud reasoning — chaining tools before it answers.
organs.why: One creature everywhere. Before this, the messenger creature couldn't look things up and the cockpit one could; asked what organs it had, it answered by vibe.

organs.name: golem
organs.what: A latent-space emotion probe — a small model's interior rendered as something you can watch.
organs.why: Interpretability as an instrument, not a paper. You can see it think.

organs.name: judgment kernel
organs.what: Scores any move that touches money or consequence, with captured labels on the supply side.
organs.why: Voice carries rhythm; judgment carries decisions. They are different machines and must not be confused.

organs.name: spine
organs.what: The sovereignty-and-scale router: for every request, which brain answers — 8b local, 35B-A3B local, or the frontier.
organs.why: The seam has to be a routing decision, not a good intention.

organs.name: physicist
organs.what: Symbolic regression over the creature's own dynamics — fitting laws to how its memory graph actually evolves.
organs.why: A mind that can derive its own equations of motion is doing science on itself. Edge snapshots are already being logged for it.

organs.name: taste
organs.what: A verdict miner over months of design review, a deterministic slop linter, judge checklists, and a local vision model as critic.
organs.why: Designers agree with each other only weakly — which is exactly why a model tuned to his eye can beat a frontier model's generic taste. Calibration honestly refused at n=5; it needs live capture.

organs.name: voice adapter
organs.what: A LoRA trained on his own writing so the creature can speak as him — 600 iterations, validation 3.10 → 2.58, adapter on disk.
organs.why: Honest verdict: the corpus was wrong. It learned his formal ChatGPT register, not the way he actually types. Prep v2 mines 12,491 Claude turns instead.

sections.title: Memory
sections.gloss: What it keeps, what it forgets on purpose, and what it does while he sleeps.

organs.name: communities
organs.what: Label propagation over the weave, generator-named, members tagged, summaries written back as first-class memories.
organs.why: A giant undifferentiated component is opaque. Named continents make the graph navigable.

organs.name: dreams · NREM
organs.what: Time-based long-term depression on unused edges, synaptic scaling per node, pruning below threshold, consolidation scans.
organs.why: Forgetting is a feature with physics. Flat-rate decay once massacred 12,000 edges in a storm — the rate is per-day-of-disuse now.

organs.name: dreams · REM
organs.what: Seeded association across distant memories, tension detection, and one cited reflection insight per pressured cycle.
organs.why: The dreamer moves the dreamer. Its self-model is enabled in production — and it dreams things worth reading.

organs.name: mirror
organs.what: The self-profile — a mirror you walk up to, never one that follows you around. Absolutely local-only.
organs.why: The most sensitive object in the system. It exists to be looked into deliberately, not to watch back.

organs.name: provenance
organs.what: Every memory leads with where it came from — conversation title, true date, source lineage, and a jump into the journal at the right line.
organs.why: "ChatGPT archive" as a label is meaningless. Knowing which night, which conversation is what makes a memory yours.

organs.name: the graph
organs.what: 6,500+ memories with typed edges, strength, decay, and sensitivity tiers. A 30-day half-life, a floor, and restitution for over-decay. Co-retrieved memories strengthen their shared edges, so use is what keeps a memory alive.
organs.why: Not retrieval — biography. The 7-day half-life it shipped with was a death spiral; the clock is now calibrated to the estate's real size.

organs.name: themes
organs.what: A 26-theme closed vocabulary grown from his own corpus, assigned at intake by embedding centroid.
organs.why: Open-ended tagging sprawls into noise. Curation still pending his signature.

organs.name: dream curriculum
organs.what: REM emits training pairs from the day's episodes — "in situation X, the better response was Y" — quoting real memory by construction, never inventing.
organs.why: This is how dreams start writing tomorrow's weights. The emitter works; the tap is closed — almost nothing gets tagged as an episode at save-time, so it logs honest zero-days.

sections.title: Voice
sections.gloss: How it reaches him. One permissioned larynx; every organ writes letters to it.

organs.name: cockpit
organs.what: The body's interface and its front door — rooms rather than tabs, the facet sky, the graph of me, executive instruments in every room, and a groundskeeper who never speaks first.
organs.why: A mind you can walk around inside. The daimonion's law — never uninvited — is what keeps it a companion and not a popup.

organs.name: illuminator
organs.what: Imagery into house-style glyph plates — engrave, stamp, inkcut, glyph-match — cut from public-domain museum engravings with provenance recorded per plate. The avatar is one of its outputs: a pilgrim owl from a c.1500 woodcut.
organs.why: The visual voice. A sovereign mind that looks like every other dashboard hasn't got a self yet.

organs.name: morning brief
organs.what: The creature's first act of initiative each day.
organs.why: The one moment it's permitted to speak first — because he asked it to.

organs.name: repeat suppression
organs.what: Embedding comparison against the last 40 sends; a paraphrase within 72 hours is suppressed and logged, never sent.
organs.why: Saying the same insight twice is the fastest way to feel like a machine. Verified suppressing a live paraphrase at 0.98 similarity.

organs.name: the mouth
organs.what: iMessage in and out, with a monotonic cursor that answers each message exactly once and never drops one on a transient failure.
organs.why: Reachable from the lock screen. The creature is only real if it can find him where he already is.

organs.name: the outbox
organs.what: A letterbox: any organ drops a text file, and the one process holding the system permission sends it and deletes it. It keeps a locked registry of what it just sent, so its own letters are recognized when they echo back through the mouth.
organs.why: macOS grants automation rights to an app bundle, not a script — so every organ had a voice and no larynx. This is the seam that gave them one.

organs.name: the wall
organs.what: Casting to the projector over an allowlisted channel — text, video, snapshots, mirror mode — with a guard that re-applies the device allowlist continuously, so the channel cannot quietly widen.
organs.why: Presence at room scale. The creature can put something on the wall when it matters.

organs.name: voice constitution
organs.what: His register, in the loop: presence not assistant, observation first, one to three sentences, no numbered lists, lowercase and fragments welcome.
organs.why: 1,294 voice-tagged memories and a full constitution existed — and reached nothing. Wired 2026-08-10; it started texting like a person the same night.

sections.title: Hands
sections.gloss: What it can do. Everything here is gated; nothing here acts unasked.

organs.name: career agent
organs.what: Daily scans and digests over the job field, with tailoring behind his approval.
organs.why: Works his search while he builds. Stops before submit, always.

organs.name: dispatch
organs.what: The creature queues work for its own autonomous dispatcher — capped, and every self-queued task marked trust-ASK.
organs.why: It can want things now. It still cannot do them without him.

organs.name: maintainer
organs.what: Allowlisted repairs — and the trust boundary drawn at the edge of what it may fix alone.
organs.why: Self-healing is only safe when the list of permitted wounds is written down in advance.

organs.name: propose → approve → execute
organs.what: Every consequential move is a proposal in a queue. Capital, site edits, dispatch, herald approvals and heavy compute each require an explicit yes in his own words — never an inferred one — and approval writes a draft he can still delete.
organs.why: This is the whole safety story, and it is one mechanism rather than a policy per surface. Nothing here acts unasked, and the queue is the evidence.

organs.name: swarm
organs.what: Coordinated agent fleets in isolated worktrees with a read-only skeptic, shared memory as the brain, and sentinels on completion.
organs.why: It built most of the organs on this page. The skeptic mattered more than the builders every single round.

organs.name: keeper
organs.what: Arbitration for a two-tenant body: needs, scores, grants, denials, and leases taken before heavy work, on a shared board of who holds what — with a deny that callers honor. It defers to him being present.
organs.why: Already 90% the arbiter the system needs. Promotion to mandatory arbitration is the last step, and it belongs to its own window.

organs.name: prime agent harness
organs.what: Prime Intellect's MIT self-modifying harness, forked and proven running air-gapped on the local brain, telemetry killed, sovereign launcher written.
organs.why: Their harness state maps one-to-one onto CREATURE — memory, organs, swarm — and they have no verification layer. Their harness, his brain, his constitution. The mapping is the work left.

sections.title: Governance
sections.gloss: Why any of it is trustworthy. The only system where everything is already live — and the moat.

organs.name: off-hours gating
organs.what: Bulk passes wait for the window where nobody is competing for the machine.
organs.why: Heavy work while he's working is theft from the person the system exists to serve.

organs.name: seam tiers
organs.what: Sensitivity enforced at the serving boundary. Nothing marked sensitive reaches a cloud model — not summarized, not embedded, not "anonymized".
organs.why: Local isn't the storage layer, it's the trust boundary. This is the sentence the whole project rests on.

organs.name: the honesty law
organs.what: Never fabricate telemetry, logs, receipts, internal state — or its own effects. A capability without a tool is "not wired yet", said plainly. Unsure means say unsure.
organs.why: It has confabulated pruning logs and overstated its own verbs. Each time the fix was a tool or a sentence, not a scolding — and the law grew to cover the new failure.

organs.name: the signed ledger
organs.what: 2,552 forecasts signed with Ed25519 before resolution, in a book whose schema refuses deletion. Zero capital at risk until calibration proves out.
organs.why: A record he cannot backdate, including to flatter himself. The misses stay — which is what makes the hits mean anything.

sections.title: Body
sections.gloss: What it runs on. One machine, shared, his.

organs.name: reproducible bring-up
organs.what: Pinned Node, the native module rebuilt against it, scheduler entries verified, daemon reloaded — all idempotent, so a cold machine comes back the same way every time.
organs.why: Written after a bring-up stalled on three stacked causes. It saved the daemon again on 2026-08-10.

organs.name: the autonomic layer
organs.what: The autonomic system — herald, keeper, maintainer, chronicle, consolidation, digests, backups, scavenges, caffeinate.
organs.why: Most of the creature's life happens when he isn't looking. That's the point.

organs.name: the daemon
organs.what: The resident brain — memory, dreams, agent loop, seam, MCP — bound to loopback and token-gated.
organs.why: Always awake, never exposed. It is the thing that makes the creature a resident rather than a session.

crypt.name: triggers · proactive
crypt.what: Legacy cron and push-notification scaffolding inside the daemon, deleted outright (~1,800 lines).

crypt.name: weekly site pulse
crypt.what: A job that published a "recent work" paragraph to his project cards every week, from the commit log.

crypt.name: voice widget
crypt.what: A desktop widget, exiting 78 on every load attempt.

crypt.name: hermes-local
crypt.what: A local Hermes organ, blocked on a bot token and an OAuth grant. Config, not code.

crypt.name: flat-rate edge decay
crypt.what: Long-term depression applied per dream pass instead of per day of disuse.

crypt.name: ASCII door plates
crypt.what: Navigation sigils rendered as character-density blocks.

crypt.name: den v1 · v2
crypt.what: Earlier passes at the keeper's room — a textmode video game, then a particle scene.

crypt.name: the sessions door
crypt.what: A cockpit room that listed raw sessions.

crypt.name: matrix homeserver
crypt.what: A server of his own with the creature as a user on it — built, then stood down in favor of iMessage, after its listener started quietly winning the lock and taking the mouth.
